lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple large-scale public hearings covering a dense cluster of new buildings in Backman Village, and public input matters at this stage. That same day, HARC also takes up accessibility renovations at Town Hall and an addition to the Parks & Rec building. Then on Thursday, San Miguel County holds its sixth working session on the Land Use Code rewrite, focused on zoning, density, and regulatory tools to expand workforce and affordable housing.

notable.stake: Preliminary large-scale public hearings on major Carhenge redevelopment project.
HARC votes on alterations to two Town-owned landmark and civic buildings.
County shapes final affordable-housing code rewrite with zoning and density changes.
